ideas.concept: Visually striking image of a human hand interacting with a glowing AI interface. Caption highlights how AI enhances, not replaces, human connection in call centers, leading to better customer experiences. Focus on the seamless collaboration between humans and AI.

prompts: Close-up shot of a diverse human hand gently touching a shimmering, holographic AI interface that displays abstract data visualizations. Style: Digital art, futuristic, ethereal. Color palette: Pastel blues, teals, and whites with subtle glowing accents. Composition: Focus on the hand and interface, using shallow depth of field.

Composition: Dynamic angle, leading lines towards the interface and agents in the background, creating depth.

expect.offline: The template's own pinData pins step 2 and all three Gemini chains and the Replicate call (its prediction, status processing, output URL on replicate.delivery), so on both sides no model is asked and Replicate is not called; the pinned topic ('Call Center Transformation with Artificial Intelligence') is what the chains would have produced, whatever the sheet says. The sheet row still decides whether the run continues and which Topic the status update matches. 6b is a parameterless Wait v1.1 (5 seconds). A canned n8n run (2026-11-15) stops at node 4 with `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'message')` (n8n-core normalizeNodeErrors): the bench hands the template's pinData to n8n as stored, without the {json} wrapper, so the pinned Replicate prediction's top-level `error: null` reads as an item error (PROPOSALS P60)
